records.observation: Russian standards and a current mass-market chain show polished rice across multiple grain types. This supports a generic category identity but also demonstrates why an unqualified source term must not be forced into current long-grain RICE_WHITE.
3.2% pasteurized drinking milk is a standardized and current retail form. Market evidence is identity/availability evidence, not a complete nutrient-vector source.

Fresh parsley root is commercially available, including an SPB/LO B2B supplier. The bounded search does not establish ordinary mass-market-chain coverage, so default automatic eligibility is not granted.
